claims.claim: Provides 1,000 fellowship slots annually for OBC students pursuing M.Phil. and Ph.D. in Indian universities.
claims.sourceTitle: Guidelines for National Fellowship for Other Backward Classes (NF-OBC)
claims.sourcePublisher: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
claims.evidenceQuote: The scheme provides 1,000 slots per year to Other Backward Classes (OBC) students for pursuing higher studies leading to M.Phil. and Ph.D. degrees.

claims.claim: Fellowship rates match UGC scales: JRF ₹37,000/month (first 2 years) and SRF ₹42,000/month (remaining 3 years).
claims.sourceTitle: UGC Revision of Fellowship Rates for Research Scholars
claims.evidenceQuote: UGC revised the Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) rate to Rs. 37,000 per month and Senior Research Fellowship (SRF) to Rs. 42,000 per month.

claims.claim: Implemented through NBCFDC and UGC with income ceiling of ₹8.00 Lakh per annum.
claims.sourcePublisher: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
claims.evidenceQuote: Implemented through NBCFDC/UGC for OBC Non-Creamy Layer students having total family income not exceeding Rs. 8.00 lakh per annum.
claims.notes: Implementing agency and income ceiling confirmed.

crossSchemeRelationship: Specialized central sector fellowship under MoSJE OBC Welfare portfolio.
examTrapVerified: Confirmed: 1,000 annual slots (not 300); updated to ₹37k/₹42k rates.
